title: V5: seal loop suppression rate — 100s console summary (ERROR if >1%)
brief: Owner does not see seal suppression in proposer console; throughput review found ~93% tick suppression but most lines are DEBUG (quorum_pending pre_timeout). Add operator-visible aggregate: every 100s wall clock on proposer seal loop, log suppression_pct = suppressed_ticks / seal_loop_ticks * 100; if suppression_pct > 1.0 use error! (red #ERROR in stderr), else info!. Counters reset each 100s window. Do not spam per-tick WARN for normal quorum_pending.

owner_requirement.metric: percent of seal-loop iterations suppressed (cluster gate or lease gate fail before seal)

context_from_review.why_console_quiet: run_cluster_gate quorum_pending uses debug!(); only quorum_timeout uses warn!()
context_from_review.log_line_grep_inflates: Historical log counts include DEBUG lines owner never sees on default console level

counters_per_100s_window.seal_loop_ticks: increment once per loop iteration that reaches proposer seal path (after sleep, before seal success)
counters_per_100s_window.seal_loop_ticks_suppressed: increment when run_lease_gate returns false OR run_cluster_gate returns false (same paths that today bump pending_ticks_since_last_sealed)

emit.message: seal_suppression_summary window_sec=100 ticks={} suppressed={} suppression_pct={:.2} sealed_in_window={}
emit.reset: zero counters and window_start after emit

design.optional_detail_on_error: When ERROR, one-line breakdown: fence_suppressed vs cluster_suppressed counts in same window (helps owner reconcile with review)
non_goals: Promote every debug quorum_pending to WARN (too noisy)

acceptance_criteria: Proposer stderr shows seal_suppression_summary at least every ~100s at INFO or ERROR
When simulated or live suppression_pct > 1%, line uses #ERROR red styling (existing pwmd logging)
Unit test: helper compute_suppression_pct + threshold level selection
docs/runbooks/v5-cy-cluster-precloseout-soak.md: note seal_suppression_summary and DEBUG vs console
operator_verify: Restart proposer; within 100s expect seal_suppression_summary; on CY cluster with quorum wait expect red ERROR if review attribution holds
